verdict.rationale: Shopify's own docs and marketing say shoppers can check out in AI chats, and Checkout MCP provides complete_checkout ('Submit payment and place the order'). In-chat completion is limited to trusted Token-tier agents with purchase permission, though. The default and escalation path hands buyers off to the merchant storefront via continue_url, and the runtime probe stopped at cart creation with no checkout or payment. missing for 10: evidence naming specific surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) where in-chat checkout is live, ungated in-chat completion rather than Token-tier-only, and hands-on corroboration of a completed in-chat purchase.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)
